title: White House Names New Pandemic Preparedness Lead Amid Ebola Outbreak Concerns
detail: The White House announced new pandemic-response leadership, naming Dr. Sara Brenner — a physician and former FDA principal deputy commissioner — to lead the Office of Pandemic Preparedness and Response Policy, a position that had been unfilled through most of Trump's second term. The move responds to an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC/Uganda region along with concurrent US concerns over New World screwworm and hantavirus.

media.caption: White House names Dr. Sara Brenner to lead pandemic preparedness office

title: Dow Jones Touches Record High to Close Strongest Quarter Since 2020
detail: The Dow Jones Industrial Average touched a record intraday high before closing essentially flat at 52,305.24 (-0.03%); the S&P 500 closed at 7,483.23 (-0.22%) and the Nasdaq at 26,040.03 (-0.66%). The pullback followed the strongest quarterly performance for major US indices since 2020.

media.caption: Dow Jones touches record intraday high closing out the strongest quarter since 2020
